_comment: Quarterly reported EPS versus the matching analyst median, scaled by price.

default.name: analyst4_eps_surprise_price_delta_over_std_63_126
default.expression: group_rank(ts_delta((winsorize(ts_backfill({field}, 120), std=4) - winsorize(ts_backfill(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_epsr_median, 120), std=4)) / ts_backfill(close, 5), 63) / ts_std_dev((winsorize(ts_backfill({field}, 120), std=4) - winsorize(ts_backfill(anl4_fs_detail_estimate_1qf_v4_nd_epsr_median, 120), std=4)) / ts_backfill(close, 5), 126), subindustry)
